process_issues.description: Two test-infrastructure pitfalls cost a diagnostic cycle each: (1) a second openPage within one test was a same-document hash navigation so mount-time ?state= reads went stale (fixed in the shared helper with an about:blank hop); (2) Playwright's toBeDisabled() does not recognize disabled on a fieldset element itself, breaking every page's readonly-gate assertion until aria-disabled mirrors were added.
process_issues.detected_by: Playwright trace parsing (call-by-call timeline) for (1); toBeDisabled failure log showing 'locator resolved to <fieldset disabled …>' for (2).

process_issues.description: First-integration failures repeated the same axe classes across independently-authored pages: scrollable-region-focusable (Tasks, Facilities, Automations, Integrations), label-durability under RTL/200% (Rhythms), nested-interactive cards (Automations), aria-label on plain spans (Integrations), shared danger-button contrast on page surfaces (Projects, Facilities). Each was fixed per page; the brief was amended mid-run only for the fieldset case.
process_issues.detected_by: AxeBuilder violation nodes in error-context artifacts across waves.

issues.description: Page implementation ran on Local Codex gpt-5.6-sol per the user's explicit dispatch mandate rather than the claude coding-agent skill; contract-first discipline (red proof before implementation, no weakened assertions, cited contract corrections only) was preserved by the lead. Lead also made documented inline fixes inside page-owned files (locator disambiguations, tab-order restructure, aria fixes) when diagnosis required tooling the sandboxed owners could not run — a swarm-protocol deviation, recorded, not a W-category.
